title: Compose WMBT statements from the template

facts.note: Planner authors or edits a WMBT.
WMBT definition files / WMBT entries in plan or wagon artifacts.
Task mentions writing or revising a WMBT statement.

values: wmbt statement field added or modified
facts.note: Diff-level observer that detects the WMBT statement field changed.

fires: Planner writes a new WMBT and must fill in its statement.
Planner rewords an existing WMBT statement or changes its direction, dimension, object of control or context clarifier.
doesNotFire: Editing a WMBT's acceptances or other fields without touching the statement or its composing parts.
Writing coder-side code or tests that do not author WMBT statements.

given: A WMBT has a chosen direction, dimension, object of control and optional context clarifier.
when: The planner writes or revises the WMBT statement.
then: Compose the statement exactly as `{direction} {dimension} of {object_of_control} [context_clarifier]`, i.e. `${direction} ${dimension} of ${object_of_control}${context_clarifier ? ' ' + context_clarifier : ''}`.
prefer: Derive the statement from the WMBT's direction, dimension and object-of-control values so the text and the parts stay consistent.
Append the context clarifier after a single space only when one exists; otherwise end at the object of control.
avoid: Free-form statements that skip, reorder or rephrase the template parts (e.g. omitting the literal `of`).
Trailing spaces or placeholder text when no context clarifier is set.
why: A fixed composition makes every WMBT statement reproducible from its direction, dimension, object of control and clarifier, so statements stay comparable and machine-checkable.
evidence: Recomputing the pattern from the WMBT's direction, dimension, object_of_control and context_clarifier yields exactly the stored statement.
verifier_detail: Term `statement_pattern` (the WMBT statement composition): `${direction} ${dimension} of ${object_of_control}${context_clarifier ? ' ' + context_clarifier : ''}` — clarifier is optional and, when present, joined with one space.
